plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero for capital preservation.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced upside potential in exchange for greater stability.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to reduce overall leverage.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth by managing risk first. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns with a focus on sustainable growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs, which can lead to substantial drawdowns and daily decay. Strict stop discipline is critical for managing the higher risk.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero for income focus.
Exit SMCI and QQQ due to downtrends and being below stop.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly yield by rotating into income-focused ETFs. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to near zero, prioritizing low drawdown. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in selloffs, so this is not a savings account.
